description: Start a new chi agent run against an engine. Returns { runId, status, output?, error? }. Use iyke_chi_status to poll for output. engine_id examples: claude-code, gemini, codex. mode controls permissions: plan, default, auto, bypassPermissions.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the active project root.

parent_id.description: Optional parent run id for subagent chains.

prompt.description: Initial prompt / task for the agent.

resume_session_id.description: Optional existing engine session id to resume.

name: iyke_chi_run
